actors.concept: Half-elf cleric of the Veiled Sun, sent to recover the Crown before the new moon allows the lich to reclaim it.
relationships: order bond with the Veiled Sun temple
protective of Seraphine despite disapproving of her methods

actors.concept: Human necromancer who believes the lich-king's power can be studied and contained — not just destroyed.
relationships: the Spectral Advisor may know her by name
Aldric distrusts her interest in the lich's power

actors.concept: Halfling tomb-delver hired by the temple. Has been in this ziggurat before — and came back alone.
relationships: lost his previous party in this tomb
owes the temple a debt he refuses to name

actors.concept: The Forgotten King, risen as a lich four centuries ago. Sealed below his own throne. On the new moon, the seals break and he fully reawakens.
actors.instinct: Reclaim the Sundered Crown and complete his ascension. Let nothing that breathes leave the tomb.

actors.concept: The king's most loyal servant, bound to the tomb in death. Negotiation is possible — he values ritual propriety over bloodshed.
actors.instinct: Assess the party's worthiness. Destroy the unworthy. Bargain with those who understand the old ways.

actors.concept: A massive construct of fused bone, animated by the lich's residual will. Patrols the ossuary approach.
actors.instinct: Crush all who disturb the king's remains. It does not negotiate.

actors.concept: The king's former court wizard, trapped as a spirit. He knows the lich's true weakness and will share it — for a price the party may not be willing to pay.
actors.instinct: Guide worthy souls toward the lich's binding. Test them first.

actors.concept: Twelve skeletons standing in ceremonial posture in the Servants' Hall. Dormant unless the king commands — or the hall is desecrated.
actors.instinct: Remain still. Obey the king's last command. Strike when the hall is dishonored.

clocks.label: The New Moon Approaches
clocks.stakes: The new moon marks the moment the lich's seals break and he fully reawakens.
clocks.completion_effect: The lich-king rises in full power. The tomb becomes his domain entirely — the party fights for survival, not objective.
clocks.notes: When full, the lich's seals break and he fully reawakens. Each scene spent in the tomb advances this. The deadline is structural.

clocks.label: The Bone Warden Stirs
clocks.stakes: The Bone Warden's patrols are becoming more alert as sound carries through the ossuary.
clocks.completion_effect: The Bone Warden abandons its patrol pattern and charges. It will not stop until the party leaves the ossuary level.
clocks.notes: Advances with noise, combat, or disturbance of remains. When full, the Bone Warden abandons its patrol pattern and hunts the party.

clocks.label: The Lich Senses Intruders
clocks.stakes: Each use of magic or arcane study deepens the lich's awareness of living presences in his tomb.
clocks.completion_effect: The lich begins exerting direct will over the dungeon — doors seal, skeletons animate on command, and temperature drops to a killing cold.
clocks.notes: Advances when sanctified areas are disturbed, undead are destroyed, or magic is used within the tomb. When full, the lich begins exerting direct influence over the dungeon.

clocks.label: The Crown Calls to the King
clocks.stakes: The Sundered Crown resonates with the lich's rising power each time magic is wielded near it.
clocks.completion_effect: The crown begins moving toward the throne on its own. Anyone carrying it feels the pull as a mounting compulsion.
clocks.notes: The Sundered Crown resonates with the lich's awakening. Advances when the crown is handled, when the lich is invoked, or when necrotic magic is used. When full, the crown begins moving toward the throne on its own.

clocks.label: The Dungeon Learns What Comforts You
clocks.stakes: Four centuries of death have made the tomb sensitive to the living's fears and consolations.
clocks.completion_effect: The dungeon begins weaving personalized visions: refuge that is a trap, comfort that is poison. Each party member faces a tailored horror.
clocks.notes: The tomb has been inhabited by death for 400 years. It develops an eerie emotional awareness of the party. Advances on fear, grief, or revealed vulnerabilities. When full, the dungeon begins exploiting personal weaknesses.

clocks.label: The Servants' Hall Silence Breaks
clocks.stakes: The ceremonial silence required to keep the skeleton guardians dormant is becoming precarious.
clocks.completion_effect: The twelve skeleton guardians animate simultaneously. Combat in the Servants' Hall is now unavoidable.

clocks.label: The Upper Tomb Patrols Mobilize
clocks.stakes: The undead patrols scattered through the ziggurat's upper level are responding to disturbances below.
clocks.completion_effect: Ambushes become possible in every room on Level 1. The party can no longer safely rest or regroup on the upper level.

clocks.label: Recover the Sundered Crown
clocks.stakes: Each failure narrows the window to locate and retrieve the Crown before the lich reawakens.
clocks.completion_effect: The Sundered Crown is secured. The party can attempt to flee or use it to bind the lich permanently.

clocks.label: Dax Remembers the Truth
clocks.stakes: Each time Dax navigates the tomb, fragments of his previous expedition surface unbidden.
clocks.completion_effect: Dax finally remembers: he didn't just escape — he sealed the door behind him while his companions were still inside. The guilt becomes a wound that costs composure on failed rolls.

clocks.label: The Wraith-Steward Seals the Passages
clocks.stakes: The Wraith-Steward is methodically closing off passage routes deeper into the tomb as he assesses the party's intent.
clocks.completion_effect: The main descent to Level 3 is sealed by the Wraith-Steward's power. The party must negotiate with him or find an alternative passage.

memories.title: The New Moon Deadline
memories.summary: The party must recover the Sundered Crown before the new moon, when the lich-king fully reawakens. The temple's seers gave them a narrow window — perhaps three days.

memories.title: The King Rose as a Lich
memories.summary: Four centuries ago, the Forgotten King performed the Rite of Undying to cheat death. His own court sealed him below the ziggurat rather than face him in open war. The seals hold — for now.

memories.title: Dax Came Back Alone
memories.summary: Dax entered this tomb once before with a party of four. He left alone and has never explained what happened to the others. He knows passages and dangers the others do not.

memories.title: The Wraith-Steward Can Be Bargained With
memories.summary: Temple records suggest the Wraith-Steward values ritual propriety above violence. Those who approach him with the correct forms of address may negotiate passage rather than fight.

memories.title: The Drowned Shrine Is Still Active
memories.summary: The Shrine of Mythrax on Level 1 still conducts necromantic energy. The silver dust on the floor responds to living footsteps — disturbing it may alert something below.

memories.title: Seraphine Wants to Study the Lich
memories.summary: Seraphine believes the lich-king's binding ritual contains secrets about undeath that could revolutionize magical theory. Her interest in the crown is academic as much as practical — and Aldric suspects she is not committed to destroying it.

memories.title: The Bone Warden Patrols the Ossuary
memories.summary: The massive bone construct is the primary active threat on Level 3. Noise on the approach advances its alertness. It cannot be destroyed by conventional means — only dispersed temporarily.

memories.title: Aldric's Order Sent Him Alone
memories.summary: The Veiled Sun temple dispatched Aldric without backup because the other priests refused the mission — they believe the tomb cannot be safely entered. Aldric is the only one who volunteered.

memories.title: The Spectral Advisor Knows the Binding
memories.summary: The court wizard's spirit in the Advisor's Nook claims to know a method to permanently bind the lich rather than dispel him temporarily. The cost of this knowledge is not yet known.

memories.title: The Tomb Breathes
memories.summary: The basalt walls of the ziggurat exhale cold air in slow, rhythmic pulses — not wind, not vents. As if something immense is sleeping below and dreaming of the party's presence.

room_threats.notes: The shrine of Mythrax is the most spiritually active room on Level 1. Any interaction advances the-lich-senses-intruders clock.
The twelve ceremonial skeletons are dormant unless the hall is dishonored. Advances servants-hall-silence-breaks and the-lich-senses-intruders clocks.
The walls of stacked skulls amplify sound. Advances the-bone-warden-stirs clock, which is scoped to this room.
Attacking the Wraith-Steward without attempting negotiation seals the Descent Chamber and alerts the lich. Advances the-lich-senses-intruders.
The climax room. Any magical action accelerates the-crown-calls-to-the-king and the-new-moon-approaches clocks.
